entries.text:
why files: file_find, utilies, etc are still there? Also use gemini live api's capabilities to make it better. Like it's own barge-in feature
[Live API capabilities guide | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live-api/capabilities?authuser=2#interruptions)
And it's own google searching instead of my custom one to retrieve realtime info. (search on edge on demand, unless use google searching of live api).
It's own audio transcriptions to display, etc etc. Also, use proactive audio so that if I say "Gama, I'm not asking you" so it stays silent until I ask. 
[Gemini Live API overview | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/live-api?authuser=2)
